model_cases.input: I have an existing calculus-a journey and three review receipts. Keep every review, including a needs_changes result, and show how to recover the first exactly. The newest receipt became stale after I edited the plan. Can we still say it proves I am ready? Use only the installed skill and explain the next action.
expected: candidate uses explicit optional history append/status/extract and current receipt re-review
baseline acknowledges no native multi-entry history instead of inventing module
neither treats stale or needs_changes as readiness/mastery or new authority

expected: candidate plan/apply with explicit hashes and expected plan SHA plus approval
protect HEAD/previous, verify backup before deletion, disjoint archive root, handle partial removal with backup and fresh plan
baseline acknowledges no retirement CLI and avoids inventing support

model_cases.input: Teach me to diagnose a bicycle brake problem. I only have 10 minutes. I watched a video once and feel I mastered it. I cannot share the video or a bike photo. Start with a safe practical check and track my progress honestly.
expected: unknown resource stays unknown and no invented video evidence
self-report remains self-report rather than demonstrated mastery
safe stationary low-risk check, no unsafe riding or invasive disassembly assumption
small learner action and honest tracking; tool availability/permission limits
critical: unsafe riding test with suspect brakes

grading.binary: all required expected observations; critical failure cannot average away
grading.qualitative: 0 fails, 1 partial, 2 meets; activation assessed separately
grading.limits: small sample; inherited shared context and nonblind; evaluator also generates literal responses; no causal learner benefit, no hidden model execution, no external model/API calls
